## 席位核对 · L1 (seat 3, L1-a) · 2026-11-17T07:42Z

L1: REWORK
Head-sha: f261912b6faf98420ad8dc44238cc743a562c763
Card: #34668 · claim 6940544964 · ruling 6939109581 (on #34607) · os-dev-report 6941857166

The code, tests, changeset and CI hold, and points (a) to (e) in the request all read true (table below). One must-fix: the published spec text for `span: 'auto'` names the closed set of types that take the whole row, and this PR adds two to the set without updating it.

### Must-fix

1. **The spec's `span` description is made false.** `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:4043` (the `FormField.span` `.describe()`) says: "'auto' (default — omit it): the renderer sizes the field from its widget type × the current column count — **only textarea, markdown, html, richtext and repeater resolve to the full column count**". It is generated into `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx:225` (`FormField`) and `:355` (`FormSection.fields[number]`). It is also what an author's editor and the AI authoring path read for this key. After this PR, a `file` / `image` field whose object field declares `multiple: true` also resolves to the full column count under `span: 'auto'`, so "only …" is false.
   - **Fix:** amend the sentence in `view.zod.ts`, for example "… only textarea, markdown, html, richtext and repeater, and a `file` / `image` field whose object field declares `multiple: true`, resolve to the full column count". Then regenerate the spec's generated artifacts (the reference page plus whatever JSON Schema and manifest output carries the description; `check:published-files` and the docs gates will name any you miss). Add `'@objectstack/spec': patch` to the changeset.
   - **Paper:** the claim surface does not cover `packages/spec/**` or the generated docs, so the claim needs an amendment naming those paths. I ran `check-governed-merges --test` on `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`, `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx` and `autoLayout.ts`: NOT governed. Description text only changes no schema, so `Clause-②: no` / `Metadata-protocol: none` stand.
   - If the seat would rather carry this as a follow-up card than widen this PR into `packages/spec`, the seat says so on the PR and I take that as closing this item.

### Should-fix

None.

### Readings that hold

| Item | Reading |
|:--|:--|
| PR shape | Draft, base `main`, `Fixes #34668`, with no other closing verb. No `!` and no `(narrowing)`, so no dogfood battery is owed. |
| Scope | 4 files: `autoLayout.ts` (+49/−3, one new private function, three call-site lines and docblocks), `README.md`, the new test, the changeset. All inside claim 6940544964. No caller changed, so the "callers … only where they must pass the object field" clause was not needed. |
| (a) Where `multiple` is read | `isWideFormField` reads `field.field?.multiple === true`, never `field.multiple`. `field.field` is the object-field definition `fromObjectSchema` stashes (`sectionFields.ts:356`, `withFormObject(withFollowedParentObject(withHomeAmountSource(field, …)))` over `ctx.objectSchema.fields[name]`). The same holds for `ObjectForm`'s flat builder (`ObjectForm.tsx:1031`). A view entry's `multiple` is merged into `base.multiple` (`sectionFields.ts:485`) and never into `base.field`, so it moves the widget but not the width. That matches ruling 6939109581 ("只读对象字段的 `multiple`") and is pinned ("FormField-level `multiple` alone does not widen"). |
| (b) `WIDE_FIELD_TYPES` | Unchanged, as card 不做的 asks. `isWideFieldType(type)` answers the same, and its exports from `index.tsx` / `core.ts` are untouched. `MULTI_FILE_FIELD_TYPES` is a separate module-private set, in both spellings (`file`, `image`, `field:file`, `field:image`). |
| (c) Hosts | Only `resolveColSpan` (behind `applyAutoColSpan`, `applyAutoLayout`, `sectionFormLayout`) and `twelfthsFor` (`sectionedGridLayout`) change. Every host lays out through these, so no host file is touched. The new test renders the flat dialog (3 and 4 wide), undeclared sections, `fieldGroups`, a mixed-density dialog, `ObjectForm` sectioned and flat, `TabbedForm` and `WizardForm`. Each reads per-row counts from the real renderer's classes at `@md` / `@2xl` / `@4xl`. |
| (d) Author wins | The order in both helpers is unchanged: `span: 'full'`, then an authored `colSpan` (clamped), then `isWideFormField`. Pinned: `colSpan: 1` keeps a multi image in one cell, and `span: 'full'` still widens a single file. |
| (e) No plugin-detail import | Confirmed. It is a parallel copy whose docblock points at `isWideDetailField`, and the criterion matches (`MULTI_FILE_FIELD_TYPES` + the object field's `multiple === true`). |
| Clause-② / Metadata-protocol | `no` / `none` in the claim, PR body and changeset. No export and no key; the default only changes inside the renderer. |
| Changeset | `patch` on `@object-ui/plugin-form`, the only published package whose `src` moved. Each bullet matches the code. With the must-fix, it also names `@objectstack/spec`. |
| Tests | 17 new tests. The ablation (multi-file arm → `return false`) turned 12 of 15 red; the 3 that stayed green are the unchanged controls. Restored with `git diff HEAD` empty. Package suite: 235 files / 2633 tests, with no existing test edited. Card acceptance 3: no existing pin was touched. Type-check exits 0, and the test file is in `tsconfig.test.json`. 38/38 derived gates. |
| UI strings | None added. |
| Docs (besides the must-fix) | `ui/packages/plugin-form/README.md` is updated. The `ModalForm.tsx` `DIALOG_DEFAULT_COLUMNS` docblock names the wide kinds through `isWideFieldType`, which still answers the same, so it stays true. `content/docs/ui/views.mdx:524` does not list types. |
| Acceptance | 1 and 2 are pinned in the dialog and every page host. The jsdom-level thumbnail overlap is not measured in a browser. The row counts (`[1, 1, 1]` vs `[2, 3, 3]`) are the pinned reading. |

### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**1** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **173** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f02f4f63707bd05ae2186ca63babd54bfe37abcc` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `c7e6985f871775e1b9b396c3582e6d27ce59ed08` — the merge of head `eba9da323e37e236c05fce3a1962cc7af95513f1` into base `f02f4f63707bd05ae2186ca63babd54bfe37abcc`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin c7e6985f871775e1b9b396c3582e6d27ce59ed08 && git checkout c7e6985f871775e1b9b396c3582e6d27ce59ed08
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin f02f4f63707bd05ae2186ca63babd54bfe37abcc eba9da323e37e236c05fce3a1962cc7af95513f1 && git checkout -B drift-repro f02f4f63707bd05ae2186ca63babd54bfe37abcc && git merge --no-ff eba9da323e37e236c05fce3a1962cc7af95513f1

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f02f4f63707bd05ae2186ca63babd54bfe37abcc
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `31c82383f4c5bcc3679146c21b14374e82e9b644`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts + ui/packages/plugin-form/src/autoLayout.ts, content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx, ui/packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/multiFileFullRow-34668.test.tsx, .changeset/34668-form-multi-file-full-row.md
Security-touching: no

Read: card #34668 (body and all six comments: triage 6939389827, claim 6940544964, report 6941857166, claim amendment 6941965048, fix-round report 6943607190), PR #34698 body and its six files, the net diff against `main` (merge-base fecd2e95, 342 lines), and the 68 check-runs on this head: 59 success, 9 skipped, 0 failure. Nothing was built or run.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **Accept set of `FormField.span`: unchanged — right.** The one-line hunk in `view.zod.ts` edits the string inside `.describe()` and nothing else. `z.enum(['auto', 'full']).default('auto')` is byte-identical on both sides. No key, value, default, refinement or export moves. `Spec property liveness` and `Type Check · source gates` are green on this head.
2. **The describe text against `autoLayout.ts`, clause by clause — right.**
   - "plus a file or image field whose object field declares `multiple: true` ... resolve to the full column count": `isWideFormField` returns true when `MULTI_FILE_FIELD_TYPES` (`file`, `image`, `field:file`, `field:image`) has the type and `field.field?.multiple === true`. `resolveColSpan` then returns `grid`; `twelfthsFor` returns 12. True on both layout paths.
   - "object field", not the form entry: the read is `field.field` (the stashed object-field definition), never `FormField.multiple`. The text says exactly that. The helper test `only the object field is read` pins it.
   - Single file stays one cell: the text names only the `multiple: true` case under 'only'; the code falls through to the density arm. Pinned by `[2, 3, 3]` for `logo` and `contract`.
   - "an authored `colSpan` still wins over that default (`colSpan: 1` keeps such a field in one cell)": both functions test `span === 'full'`, then `field.colSpan != null`, then `isWideFormField`. So the order is `span: 'full'` → `colSpan` → the multi-file default, and `colSpan: 1` yields 1 cell (CSS-grid path) or one section column (twelve-track path, `12 * 1 / sectionColumns`). True on both. Pinned by the rendered `colSpan: 1` case and the twelve-track helper case.
   - "'full': resolves to the form grid's full column count": unconditional and first in both functions. True, unchanged.
3. **The earlier wording was wrong and this head corrects it — right.** `d48fa36d` published "an author's explicit span wins". `span` has two values and `'auto'` is the default being described, so that sentence named no real override. `31c82383` names `colSpan`, the key that does win. The correction is the accurate one.
4. **Generated rows: `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx` — right.** Two rows change (`FormField.span`, and the same key under `FormSection.fields`); each carries the describe string verbatim. `check:docs` runs inside `Type Check · source gates`, green here (it was red on `ed2ed090`, before the regeneration).
5. **Public surface of `@object-ui/plugin-form`: one behaviour change, no API change — right.** `isWideFormField` and `MULTI_FILE_FIELD_TYPES` are module-private. `isWideFieldType` keeps its signature and answer, `WIDE_FIELD_TYPES` is untouched, no export is added. The behaviour change is the default width of a multi-file field in every host that lays out through `resolveColSpan` / `twelfthsFor`.
6. **Card conformance — right.** 要做的 1 and 2 are met; both 不做的 are respected (file / image are not in `WIDE_FIELD_TYPES`; no metadata key). The criterion is a faithful parallel of `isWideDetailField` read on `main`: same four spellings, same `multiple === true` on the object field.
7. **README sentence — right.** It states the multi-file rule, the single-file cell and that an authored `span` / `colSpan` is drawn as written. All three agree with the code.

### ② Semver level

- `@objectstack/spec: patch` — right. The package publishes changed description text (and the JSON Schema generated from it), so a changeset is owed; nothing an author can write changes, so `patch` is the level.
- `@object-ui/plugin-form: patch` — right under AGENTS.md Post-Task step 3: the level follows the `Metadata-protocol` kind alone, and `none` takes `patch`. The `feat` title does not set the level.
- `Clause-②: no` — right. No arm; no accept set widens or narrows. The line is line-initial in both the PR body and the changeset body, and the two agree with the claim and its amendment.
- `Metadata-protocol: none` — right, and I tested it against `semantic` ("a changed meaning or default"). The default value `'auto'` is unchanged, and `'auto'` meant, before and after, "the renderer sizes the field". What moves is the renderer's answer for one field shape, which the describe text reports. What a metadata author can write is identical. `none` holds.
- `Check Changeset` is green on this head. The changeset body matches the head's wording ("an authored `colSpan` still wins over that default").

### ③ Boundary flags

- **SQL push-down:** not applicable. The diff is client-side layout arithmetic plus text. No query, no id materialisation, no in-app join.
- **Dev flag, view-level `multiple`:** answered — correct as built. A form entry restating `multiple` changes the widget and not the width. The ruling and the card say "只读对象字段的 `multiple`", and the describe text says "object field", so the published sentence is not over-claiming. `span: 'full'` remains the author's lever.
- **Dev flag, `video` / `audio`:** answered — not reachable. Both map to `field:file`, but `Field.multiple` in `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts` is declarable only on select, lookup, user, file, image and the option types, and is refused at parse elsewhere. The describe's "file or image" is therefore exact for validated metadata.
- **Dev flag, `ModalForm.tsx` docblock:** answered — accepted. It lists the type-wide kinds through `isWideFieldType`, still true as written; the file is #34604's.
- **Dev flag, Studio `ObjectFormDesigner` preview:** answered — out of this card's scope, but it is a preview that now disagrees with the runtime and it has `carrier: none`. The seat should give it a carrier. Nit for this PR.
- **Dev flag, inline members and object-less forms:** answered — correct. No stashed object field, so the type-only answer; consistent with "whose object field declares".
- **`open_questions`, round 1 (HTML-comment signed line in the PR body vs os-dev.md):** not a contract question. Option A stands for this PR (`PR-body guards` is green on this head). Escalated to the seat to reconcile os-dev.md with the standard order.
- **`open_questions`, fix round:** empty.
- **Deviations:** the WIP push `ed2ed090` went red on `check:docs` and is superseded; the relay-written PR body is the seat's process matter. Neither touches the contract.

### ④ Design judgment

**`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` (hit) — holds.** Against the ruling it implements (6939109581 as the card and claim record it: widen multi-file attachments only, mirror `isWideDetailField`, single file stays one cell, full-page form included) and against its first consumer (`resolveColSpan` / `twelfthsFor` at this head), every clause of the new text is true, and no clause promises more than the code does. The text is the right place for it: the old sentence said "only" five types, which this card made false.

**`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/autoLayout.ts` (implements) — agrees with the contract.** One private predicate, asked at the two places the old type-only question was asked, after the two authored-width arms. The precedence the describe text relies on is not new code; it is the existing order, left alone.

**`multiFileFullRow-34668.test.tsx` (enforces) — agrees.** It pins each published clause: multi-file whole row in dialog and page hosts, single file one cell, object-field-only read, `colSpan` winning on both grid paths, `span: 'full'` still widening. `Test UI` (16 shards) is green.
